name: paper-writing
description: Write a LaTeX paper from a finished science-agent research record: outline, bibliography and figures from the ledger and run outputs, one agent per section, an audit of every number and citation against the record, a referee review, revision, and a PDF build
whenToUse: Call when the user asks to write, draft, or revise a paper, manuscript, or article about the research in a science-agent workspace that already has research/state.md or research/report.md. The script only sequences nodes; the paper reports the recorded research and adds no experiment, number, or source.

phases.title: Setup
phases.detail: create paper/ from the template; check for Tectonic

phases.title: Outline
phases.detail: outline: thesis, claim table, section plans, figure and table list

phases.title: Figures
phases.detail: references from ledger evidence; one agent per figure or table from run outputs

phases.title: Draft
phases.detail: one agent per section: body sections, then abstract and conclusion

phases.title: Audit
phases.detail: static check, audit of numbers and citations against the record, referee review

phases.title: Revise
phases.detail: one agent per part with open issues, then another audit

phases.title: Compile
phases.detail: build the PDF with Tectonic; fix LaTeX errors and rebuild
